about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that the most holy mysteries which Thou hast bestowed as a safeguard of our restoration may be for us a remedy both now and hereafter. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
